passives.name: Seething Strike
passives.effects: Basic attacks grant 8% bonus attack speed for 3 seconds, stacking up to 4 times for a total of 32% bonus attack speed. At maximum stacks, basic attacks also grant a Phantom stack for 6 seconds, up to 2 stacks. At 2 Phantom stacks, the next basic attack consumes all of those stacks to trigger a Phantom Hit that applies on-hit effects to the target after a 0.15-second delay.
